_readme: Copy this file to <code>.json (two-letter language code, e.g. fr.json) in the languages folder and translate the texts.
Keep {placeholders} as they are. Leave out any text you do not translate: it shows in English.
Set code, name (the language's own name) and direction (ltr, or rtl for Arabic-script languages). See README.md.

portal.app.name: Yardsyncs
portal.help.title: Help
portal.docs.title: Yardsyncs documentation
portal.assistant.title: Yardsyncs assistant
portal.assistant.placeholder: Ask how to do something, or about your bookings…
portal.assistant.note: Answers come from the guides and your own data, and can be wrong: the screens are the reference. The assistant only reads; it never books or changes anything.
portal.assistant.noteDocsOnly: Answers come from the guides and can be wrong: the screens are the reference.
portal.assistant.s.c1: How do I book trucks for a whole bill of lading?
portal.assistant.s.c2: Which of my appointments tomorrow are on hold?
portal.assistant.s.c3: Free hours tomorrow for an import pickup?
portal.assistant.s.s1: How are things at the gate right now?
portal.assistant.s.s2: How do I close an hour for crane maintenance?
portal.assistant.s.s3: What does Not cleared mean at the gate?
portal.kpi.title: KPIs
portal.kpi.onTimeNote: Arrived within the hour and the grace minutes
portal.kpi.waitNote: Arrival to gate-out; {wait} waiting at the gate
portal.kpi.chartHours: Slot use by hour of the day
portal.kpi.showTable: Show the numbers as a table
portal.fleet.title: Fleet & users
portal.brand.operatorHint: Shown for the operator's terminals in the portal, the drivers' app and messages. Empty fields take the installation's.
portal.brand.installationHint: Shown at sign-in and for terminals without an operator look of their own. Empty fields show Yardsyncs.
portal.brand.name: Name
portal.brand.tooLight: Too light for white text on buttons ({ratio}:1, at least 4.5:1 is needed). Choose a darker shade.
portal.brand.domainHint: The operator's people sign in here and see its look. A system admin sets it with the DNS name and certificate.
portal.brand.logoHint: PNG, JPEG or WebP, at most 256 KB; shown about 40 pixels high.
portal.brand.noLogo: No logo: the Yardsyncs mark shows.
portal.brand.saved: Saved. Pages opened from now on show it.
portal.fleet.noOperators: No operators yet. An operator groups the terminals one company runs, with administrators for all of them.
portal.fleet.operatorHint: Operator admins manage every terminal listed here, as a terminal admin would at each one.
portal.fleet.personalDataHint: Everything Yardsyncs holds about the driver, as a file, for a request under the personal data protection law.
portal.fleet.eraseWarn: Removes the name, ID number, mobile, phones, positions and message addresses for good. Visits stay without them. This cannot be undone.
portal.fleet.erasedNote: The driver's personal data was erased.
portal.fleet.plateHint: Arabic or Latin letters; both are matched at the gate.
portal.fleet.name: Name
portal.fleet.passwordHint: At least 10 characters with a letter and a digit. Give it to the user in person; they can change it after signing in.
portal.charges.title: Charges
portal.charges.hint: Waived charges are listed but not counted. The terminal bills them through its own system.
portal.fees.title: Fees
portal.fees.hint: Charged to the trucking company's account for each appointment; 0 means no fee. Companies see them before booking.
portal.fees.lateCancelHours: Late cancellation: within this many hours of the slot
portal.fees.lateCancelLine: Cancelling less than {hours} h before the slot: {amount}; cancelling earlier refunds the booking fee.
portal.setup.gateFinds: The gate finds the truck's appointment by
portal.setup.gateByPass: The driver's gate pass (QR code): always
portal.setup.gateByNumber: The appointment number, typed by the clerk
portal.setup.identity0: Not checked: whoever drives the booked truck
portal.setup.identity1: The appointment must name its driver
portal.setup.identity2: The named driver shows the gate pass from Yardsyncs mobile
portal.setup.identityHint: Trucks that don't meet these rules go to the trouble desk with the reason. The clerk checks the driver's ID and decides.
portal.onboard.title: Terminal set-up
portal.onboard.lead: What {terminal} has, and what it still needs. Trucks can book once the first four steps are done.
portal.onboard.moveTypes.detail: {n} move types. They are what trucks book: import pickup, export drop-off, empty return…
portal.onboard.weeklyPlan.none: No weekly plan yet: without one, no slots are made.
portal.onboard.weeklyPlan.done: A default weekly plan is in place.
portal.onboard.planHint: The same hours and trucks per slot on every day you choose. Refine it later in Capacity setup: busy hours, places per move type.
portal.onboard.planMade: The weekly plan is in place and its slots are made.
portal.onboard.slotsMade: Slots made for the booking horizon.
portal.onboard.lanes.detail: {in} in, {out} out. The gate screen and the drivers' app use them.
portal.onboard.tos.fake: Demo data, not a TOS. The IT team connects one with Terminals__{code}__Tos=N4 and the N4 settings.
portal.onboard.tos.notConnected: N4 is chosen but not connected yet: the IT team sets N4__Terminals__{code}__Url and its account.
portal.onboard.staff.detail: {n} accounts for gate clerks, planners and admins.
portal.onboard.companies.detail: {n} active companies, shared by all terminals.
portal.onboard.map.detail: {n} areas drawn. Without them drivers get no directions inside, and the pre-gate check-in is off.
portal.onboard.newHint: It starts with the usual move types, an in and an out lane and the usual booking rules. Its checklist then shows what is left.
portal.onboard.starter: Start with the usual move types, lanes and rules
portal.setup.title: Capacity setup
portal.setup.weekSummary: {slots} slots a week, room for {trucks} trucks
portal.setup.defaultHint: The default plan applies whenever no seasonal plan covers the day.
portal.setup.seasonalHint: A seasonal plan replaces the default plan between its dates; the higher priority wins when two overlap. It starts as a copy of the default plan.
portal.setup.pickCells: Drag across the grid to pick hours, or click a day or an hour to pick a whole column or row. Shift-click extends the selection.
portal.setup.readOnly: Only planners and terminal admins can change capacity.
portal.setup.quotasHint: Empty means no own limit: the move type can use the whole slot.
portal.setup.overWarning: {n} slots now have more bookings than capacity; see the slot board.
portal.setup.reservedHint: Places held back for a company or for walk-ins. Unused places go back to everyone the set number of hours before the slot.
portal.setup.releaseHint: Hours before the slot when unused reserved places are given back.
portal.setup.releaseRulesHint: Hours before the slot when a move type’s unused places become free for any move type. Empty means never.
portal.setup.cancelCutoff: Cancel or move up to (minutes before the slot)
portal.setup.maxPerTruck: Appointments per truck per day (0 = no limit)
portal.bulk.title: Bulk upload
portal.bulk.step1Hint: One row per move. Rows with the same visit number go on the same truck.
portal.bulk.noFile: No file chosen (.xlsx or .csv, up to 2 MB)
portal.bulk.step3Hint: Checking books nothing. Booking books every visit that passed; the others are listed with the reason.
portal.common.offline: The server could not be reached. Check the connection and try again.
portal.common.sessionEnded: Your session ended. Sign in again.
portal.login.title: Sign in
portal.login.lead: Book truck visits and follow them to the gate.
portal.book.title: Book a truck
portal.book.many: Several trucks (by BL or container list)
portal.book.hoursHint: Pick one or more hours. Trucks fill them in order; each container takes one place.
portal.many.pasteHint: Paste from Excel or type them: one per line, or separated by commas.
portal.many.none: None of the containers on this bill of lading are in the terminal or expected.
portal.many.pairUnknown: Sizes of typed numbers are not known: pair only if they are 20′.
portal.many.unplaced: {n} trucks have no hour yet. Pick more hours or fewer containers.
portal.many.pickHours: Pick arrival hours on the left
portal.many.assignLater: Assign the truck and driver on each appointment before it leaves.
portal.many.retry: Try the {n} not booked in other hours
portal.book.noSlots: No hours open for booking on this day. Try another day.
portal.book.bookingRefHint: For an empty pickup, a booking reference is enough.
portal.book.doneLead: The driver gets a message when anything changes. Re-check before the truck leaves.
portal.book.refused: The terminal did not accept this booking
portal.appt.title: Appointments
portal.slots.title: Slot board
portal.slots.empty: No slots on this day. Slots are created from the weekly plan.
portal.slots.adjustHint: Use a minus sign to remove, e.g. -5.
portal.slots.holidayLunar: The date is expected; it follows the moon sighting. Slots stay open unless you close them.
portal.slots.holidayFixed: Slots stay open unless you close them.
portal.slots.dayClosed: The day is closed. Trucks already booked are told.
portal.slots.noOverrides: No changes on this day; the weekly plan applies.
portal.slots.closeWarning: Trucks already booked in this hour keep their booking and are told the hour is closed.
portal.gate.title: Gate
portal.gate.noTroubles: Nobody is waiting at the trouble desk.
portal.gate.noteNeeded: Write a note before letting in or turning away.
portal.map.title: Terminal map
portal.map.lead: Blocks, gates and roads the driver app uses to guide trucks inside the terminal.
portal.map.saved: Map saved. The driver app uses it from the next route it draws.
portal.map.hintSelect: Click a block or road to edit it. Drag the map to move it, scroll to zoom. Drag a corner to reshape; drag a small dot to add a corner; double-click a corner to remove it.
portal.map.hintArea: Click the corners of the area one by one.
portal.map.hintAreaMore: Keep clicking corners. Click the first corner or press Enter to finish; Backspace takes back a corner, Escape cancels.
portal.map.hintRoad: Click along the road. Starting or ending on another road joins the two there.
portal.map.hintRoadMore: Keep clicking along the road. Click the last point again or press Enter to finish; Escape cancels.
portal.map.routeHint: Click a start and an end point to see the route a truck would take on these roads.
portal.map.noRoute: These roads do not connect the two points. Check one-way directions and that the roads meet.
portal.map.name: Name
portal.map.blockHint: Exactly as N4 names it, for example A01. Trucks are guided here when their container is in this block.
portal.map.checkIn: Entering this area checks the truck in
portal.map.ready: Every block can be reached from the gate and left to the exit.
portal.map.pNoRoads: No roads yet. Draw the roads trucks drive on.
portal.map.pNoGate: No gate area. Draw where trucks enter.
portal.map.pNoExit: No exit area. Draw where trucks leave.
portal.map.pPieces: The roads are in {n} separate pieces. Join them where they meet.
portal.map.pUnreachable: Block {block} cannot be reached from the gate.
portal.map.pNoWayOut: No way from block {block} to the exit.
portal.map.pDuplicate: Block {block} is drawn more than once.
portal.map.importHint: A GeoJSON file exported from CAD or GIS: polygons become areas (properties name, block, kind), lines become roads (oneWay).
portal.map.imported: Added {areas} areas and {roads} roads ({skipped} shapes skipped). Check them, then save.
portal.map.importNothing: The file has no polygons or lines to add.
portal.map.importBad: This is not a GeoJSON file.
portal.control.title: Control room
portal.control.comingTitle: At the gate and on the way
portal.control.noneComing: No trucks at the gate or on the way.
portal.control.silentHint: The driver app stopped sending positions inside the terminal (phone off, app closed or no signal).
portal.kpi.toBlockNote: Gate-in to reaching the first block
portal.kpi.toExitNote: Last stop done to leaving the terminal
portal.kpi.appSeenNote: Of {n} visits, the app saw the truck reach its block
portal.kpi.chartAtBlock: Time at the block by day
portal.login.forgotLead: Enter the email of your account. We send you a link to set a new password.
portal.login.forgotSent: If this email belongs to an account, a link is on its way. It works once, for one hour. Check your spam folder if it doesn't arrive.
portal.password.leadInvite: Choose the password for your Yardsyncs account
portal.password.rule: At least 10 characters with a letter and a digit.
portal.password.mismatch: The two passwords are not the same.
portal.password.done: You can sign in with your new password. Other sessions of your account were signed out.
portal.password.badLink: This link is not valid any more: it was used already, a newer one was sent, or it expired. Ask for a new one.
portal.fleet.inviteHint: The user gets an email with a link to choose their own password.
portal.fleet.ownPassword: Set a first password myself instead
portal.fleet.linkSent: A link to set the password was sent to {email}.
portal.track.title: Track containers
portal.track.lead: Where your containers stand at the terminal: in the yard, released, on hold, booked or collected. Follow the ones not ready yet to get an email when they are.
portal.track.containersHint: One per line, or separated by commas or spaces. {n} found.
portal.track.followedNote: Following {n}. You get an email when they are ready to collect.
portal.track.followedHint: Checked every 15 minutes; an email the moment one is ready to collect. Followed for 30 days, or until collected.
portal.lanes.title: Lanes and devices
portal.lanes.hint: Each gate lane, how it identifies trucks and the equipment at it. Lanes are opened and closed on the gate screen.
portal.lanes.none: No lanes yet. Add the first one below.
portal.lanes.nowManual: Lane {lane} is now worked by a clerk.
portal.lanes.identifiesNone: nothing yet: add a kiosk or a camera that reads plates or containers
portal.lanes.forAutomatic: To work automatically, this lane needs {needs}.
portal.lanes.problem.NoIdentification: a way to identify trucks: a kiosk, or a camera reading plates or container numbers
portal.lanes.noDevices: No devices recorded. A clerk works this lane.
portal.lanes.keyOnce: Copy it into the device or its adapter now: it is shown only once. Any earlier key for this device has stopped working.
portal.clerk.title: Remote clerk
portal.clerk.none: No truck is waiting. Lanes that run automatically send their exceptions here.
portal.clerk.otherCases: {n} more on the trouble desk (manual lanes)
portal.clerk.pick: Choose a truck on the left.
portal.clerk.recheckedIn: Let in: the barrier at {lane} is opening.
portal.clerk.recheckedStill: Checked again: still needs a clerk.
portal.clerk.letIn: Let in: the barrier at {lane} is opening.
portal.ticket.title: Gate ticket
portal.setup.tosGateWrite: Record each gate-in and gate-out in the TOS
portal.setup.tosGateHint: Creates the truck visit and its gate transactions in the TOS. Turn on once the TOS link has been tested; anything not taken shows on the Lanes screen.
portal.tosrec.title: Gate records in the TOS

app.signInLead: Enter the mobile number your company registered for you.
app.codeSent: We sent a 6-digit code by SMS to {mobile}.
app.noTrips: No appointments. When your company books a visit with you as the driver, it shows here.
app.offline: No connection to the server. Check your internet and try again.
app.sessionEnded: You were signed out. Sign in again.
app.gateCode: Show this code at the gate
app.startTripHint: Press when the truck sets off. The terminal checks the containers again first.
app.tripStarted: Have a safe trip. The terminal knows you are on the way.
app.noPosition: Ask the terminal where to go for this container
app.moved: The container was moved: this is its new place
app.yardOffline: The terminal system is not reachable; showing the last known places
app.yardWait: Directions appear after you pass the gate.
app.checkedIn: Checked in at the pre-gate. Wait to be called to the gate.
app.locationOff: Turn on location so the terminal knows when you will arrive.
app.sharing: Your position is shared with the terminal only on the way and inside it, also when the phone is locked; not while you wait at the gate, and not after you leave.
app.locationNoticeBody: While you drive to the terminal and inside it, Yardsyncs mobile sends your location to the terminal: to know when you will arrive, to check you in at the pre-gate and to guide you to the containers. It stops when you leave the terminal. The terminal deletes positions after a few weeks. Your company or the terminal can give you a copy of your data or erase it.
app.trackingText: Only until you reach the terminal gate.
app.trackingTextInside: Inside the terminal, until you leave: it sees when you reach your container.
app.arrivedHere: You have reached the block. The terminal knows you are here.

STATUS_RED.subject: Appointment {appointmentNo} on hold
STATUS_RED.body: Yardsyncs: appointment {appointmentNo} ({slot}) is on hold: {reason}. Do not set off until it is cleared.

STATUS_CLEARED.subject: Appointment {appointmentNo} cleared
STATUS_CLEARED.body: Yardsyncs: appointment {appointmentNo} ({slot}) is cleared. You can come at your slot time.

SLOT_REMINDER.subject: Reminder: appointment {appointmentNo}
SLOT_REMINDER.body: Yardsyncs reminder: appointment {appointmentNo} at {slot}. The gate opens for you at {gateOpens}. Moves: {items}.

SLOT_CLOSED.subject: Slot closed: appointment {appointmentNo}
SLOT_CLOSED.body: Yardsyncs: the terminal closed your slot {slot} (appointment {appointmentNo}): {reason}. Please reschedule.

CONTAINER_READY.subject: Container {container} is ready
CONTAINER_READY.body: Yardsyncs: container {container} is ready to collect at {terminal}. Book a truck in the Yardsyncs portal.

GATE_IN.subject: You are in: appointment {appointmentNo}
GATE_IN.body: Yardsyncs: appointment {appointmentNo}, you are inside the terminal. Go to {stops}. Open Yardsyncs mobile for the map.

SIGN_IN_CODE.subject: Sign-in code
SIGN_IN_CODE.body: Yardsyncs: sign-in code {code}. Valid for {minutes} minutes. Do not share it.

PASSWORD_INVITE.subject: your account is ready
PASSWORD_INVITE.body:
Hello {name},

An account was created for you on Yardsyncs. Set your password here (the link works once, for {days} days):

{link}

If you did not expect this, ignore this email.

PASSWORD_RESET.subject: set a new password
PASSWORD_RESET.body:
Hello {name},

Someone asked to reset the password of your Yardsyncs account. Set a new password here (the link works once, for {minutes} minutes):

{link}

If it wasn't you, ignore this email: your password stays as it is.
